## History

Skinner, whose maiden name was [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Crowe, went by the name Mrs. Amelia Skinner after marrying her new husband, [Thomas](../character/thomas-sowerby.md). While temporarily driving the mail carriage for [Thomas](../character/thomas-sowerby.md), she picked up [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) at [Coombe Road](../codex/places.md#coombe-road) station and drove her to [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside), entertaining [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) with stories about her suitors and marriage choices along the way.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Romance P0](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0000), [v3 ch.Romance P3](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0003), [v3 ch.Romance P5](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0005), [v3 ch.Romance P13](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0013), [v3 ch.Romance P15](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0015)_
